Lee · Listen & Shadow 20

Still Talking — where you're from, what you do, what to eat
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · WHERE ARE YOU FROM
👤 Her
Where are you from?
어디서 오셨어요?
be from ~ — ~ 출신이다
💬 Lee
What's it like in Bangkok?
방콕은 어때요?
What's it like in ~? — ~는 어때요?
같은 패턴으로 — What's it like in Paris? · What's it like in winter?
💬 Lee
I've always wanted to go there.
저 거기 꼭 가보고 싶었어요.
always wanted to ~ — 꼭 ~하고 싶었다
같은 패턴으로 — I've always wanted to learn to cook. · I've always wanted a dog.
👤 Her
The food is amazing.
음식이 진짜 좋아요.
amazing — 아주 좋은
💬 Lee
No way, really?
진짜요?
no way — 정말요? (놀랄 때)
같은 패턴으로 — No way, really? · Really? That's surprising.
💬 Lee
How long have you been in Seoul?
서울엔 온 지 얼마나 됐어요?
How long have you been ~? — ~한 지 얼마나 됐어요?
같은 패턴으로 — How long have you been travelling? · How long have you been here?
PART 2 · WHAT DO YOU DO
💬 Lee
What do you do for work?
무슨 일 하세요?
for work — 직업으로
👤 Her
I work at a hotel.
저는 호텔에서 일해요.
work at ~ — ~에서 일하다
💬 Lee
How did you get into that?
어쩌다 그 일을 하게 됐어요?
get into ~ — ~를 하게 되다
같은 패턴으로 — How did you get into running? · How did you get into wine?
💬 Lee
That sounds tough.
힘들겠네요.
That sounds ~ — ~하겠네요
같은 패턴으로 — That sounds fun. · That sounds exhausting.
💬 Lee
I'd love to hear more about that.
그 얘기 더 듣고 싶어요.
I'd love to ~ — ~하고 싶어요
같은 패턴으로 — I'd love to hear more about your trip. · I'd love to try that.
PART 3 · HAVE YOU BEEN TO
💬 Lee
Have you been to Gwangjang Market?
광장시장 가봤어요?
Have you been to ~? — ~ 가봤어요?
같은 패턴으로 — Have you been to Busan? · Have you been to that new place?
👤 Her
Not yet. What should I eat?
아직요. 뭘 먹어야 해요?
not yet — 아직요
💬 Lee
You have to try the fried chicken.
치킨은 꼭 드셔봐야 해요.
have to try ~ — ~는 꼭 먹어봐야 한다
같은 패턴으로 — You have to try the soup here. · You have to see the night market.
💬 Lee
I can take you there sometime.
제가 언제 데려가 드릴게요.
take someone there — 데려가다 · sometime — 언젠가
같은 패턴으로 — I can show you around sometime. · I can take you to my favorite place.
💬 Lee
If you like spicy food, you'll love tteokbokki.
매운 거 좋아하시면 떡볶이도 좋아하실 거예요.
If you like ~, you'll love ~ — ~를 좋아하면 ~도 좋아할 거예요
같은 패턴으로 — If you like jazz, you'll love this bar. · If you like walking, you'll love this area.
느리게 16/16 · 보통 16/16
